modules.title: Introduction to ML
modules.description: This module provides an overview of Machine Learning, covering its history, types, and applications. Students will learn the basics of supervised and unsupervised learning.

modules.title: Supervised Learning
modules.description: This module introduces supervised learning, a type of machine learning where the model learns from labeled data. Students will learn about regression and classification algorithms and how to implement them in Python.

modules.title: Unsupervised Learning
modules.description: This module introduces the concepts of unsupervised learning, including clustering, dimensionality reduction, and density estimation. It covers various algorithms such as k-means, hierarchical clustering, and principal component analysis (PCA). The goal is to learn how to identify patterns in data without prior knowledge of the correct output.

modules.title: Deep Learning
modules.description: This module introduces the fundamentals of deep learning, including neural networks and convolutional neural networks. Students will learn how to build and train deep learning models using popular libraries such as TensorFlow or PyTorch.

modules.title: Neural Networks
modules.description: This module covers the basics of neural networks, including types, architectures, and training techniques.

resources.title: Backpropagation
resources.summary: In machine learning, backpropagation is a gradient computation method commonly used for training a neural network in computing parameter updates.

modules.title: Regression Analysis
modules.description: This module covers the basics of regression analysis, including types of regression, model evaluation, and common algorithms.

resources.title: Linear regression
resources.summary: In statistics, linear regression is a model that estimates the relationship between a scalar response and one or more explanatory variables.

modules.title: Classification Algorithms
modules.description: This module covers the fundamental concepts and techniques of classification algorithms, including supervised learning methods for binary and multi-class problems.
